 Sources: Micron suspends construction of its $3B to $4.5B Fab 11E facility in Taiwan, set for 2028, due to mounting uncertainties over a local labor dispute   —  Micron Technology Inc. has suspended plans for a memory chip plant in Taiwan due to a protracted labor dispute …
